## Track Details

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

songstats_info <- read_csv("data/songstats_track.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Track Name",
    "Artists",
    "Release Date",
    "ISRC Code",
    "Duration",
    "Available Global Markets",
    "Songstats Source URL"
  ),
  Value = c(
    "Drake",
    "Alsago & Slight Shady",
    "2026-03-13",
    "CAHQJ2683690",
    "4:03 (243,421 ms)",
    "184 territories",
    "[songstats.com/track/ul9j1yr4/drake](https://songstats.com/track/ul9j1yr4/drake)"
  )
) |> 
  kable(col.names = c("Property", "Details"))
```
